description: KWT202102-S003 reports “dozens” of salon, barbershop, and health-club owners but no numeric count. This wording does not reliably establish at least 50 attendees, so E001 remains pending_threshold.
required_followup: Find contemporary, event-specific attendance reporting or another reliable record giving a human crowd count; do not convert businesses, workers, or vehicles into attendee numbers.

description: A previously opened Kuwait Times announcement says the Salons Union planned a Feb. 5 sit-in (S004), but actual occurrence and turnout are unknown. The Al-Anba headline S006 says “Saturday”; its body, publication date, exact intended day, and relationship to S004 are unverified. Neither plan is merged with the reported Feb. 6 gathering in S003.
required_followup: Verify each planned date and actual execution through accessible contemporaneous reporting or organizer/official records, then resolve whether the Feb. 5/6 reports concern one or multiple actions.

description: E001’s 6 February date is inferred by converting the Kuwait Times page timestamp from 6 February 10:46 p.m. EDT to 7 February local time and interpreting “yesterday.” The physical start/end times are absent. E002 has only an announced date, not a confirmed physical onset.
required_followup: Seek a time-stamped local report or official/organizer record for exact start, event closure, and actual execution.

description: S003 supports security prevention of the National Assembly gathering and subsequent relocation, and reports that the prime minister agreed to reconsider measures with a follow-up committee meeting planned. The final outcome and precise relationship between these actions and the gathering are not documented; arrests, beatings, killings, and shootings remain unknown. No executed event or state response is established for E002.
required_followup: Locate follow-up reporting or official records on whether measures changed, whether the meeting occurred, and any event-specific response. Preserve unknowns absent explicit evidence.

description: The Al-Anba article variants S001/S011 remain search-only. Short-path requests produced two Cache misses and one pre-HTTP DNS failure; one exact canonical web.open returned an Internal Error/inaccessible-tool result. A later exact canonical ordinary-HTTPS gate could not be used because units/latvia/2021-02/sources.jsonl changed during the immediate complete-input recheck; no request or retry followed. S011-04 had a mistyped target with zero exact matches and no request. Arab Times S002 produced a Cache miss; these are technical failures, not observed access denials.
required_followup: If the unit is resumed, review current full publisher/origin scope, save a fresh exact-target receipt and manual review, and request only if the immediate complete path/hash recheck is stable; otherwise preserve the gap.

description: Search-only seafarer hunger-strike leads S009/S010 may describe an action begun before February, but no body, onset date, public gathering evidence, numeric turnout, or state target is verified. Fuel-station workers (S015) and Mahboula workers (S016) are also search-only leads without verified publication/event dates, crowd counts, or government-directed demands. No confirmed February continuation or owner unit can be assigned.

description: Nine captured search actions produced 233 ordered result headers, including English- and Arabic-language, full-month/weekly, local-news, international, official and rights-related searches. The search yield is not comprehensive; opened local-language body coverage is limited, and no systematic newspaper archive or LexisNexis access was available. No dated/verified February Bidun assembly was established; this is not evidence none occurred.
required_followup: Continue targeted Arabic and English reporting searches by sector/region and review relevant official, rights, and archive records; do not treat open-web result counts as an absence finding.
